args.source: Fresh final public S7 source rear-quarter and rotated front-quarter images show the body shell, doors, roof, wheels and skirts seated. Compared with the prior original S7, broad white fin slabs and staircase-like protrusions are reduced to thin intake divider edges. Fine short gray fin endpoints remain visible near the lower rocker opening; native main-shell and blackmatte cavity surfaces remain gray behind the upper intake. Independent no-fin ownership and native identity-frame probes locate those cavity walls in the same skirts0 resource, rather than a separately misplaced attachment. The cleanup deliberately thins all ten fin groups; exact indices/topology/Y spans/welded copies are retained. Native surface contacts and game shader fidelity are unestablished, and no zero-contact/all-angle guarantee is claimed.

records.request: Summarize the newly observed final public S7 source preview's fin-cleanup result and its remaining visible limitations.
records.value: The S7 broad fin protrusions are reduced to thin dividers in two final public source views; small endpoints and native cavity surfaces remain qualified.
